p: reign of Zedekiah king of Judah: When Jeremiah began to bear these bonds and yokes.
fourth year: After the land had rested, as in Le 25:2.
Gibeon: This was a city in Benjamin belonging to the sons of Aaron, Jos 21:17.
prophet Hananiah in the presence of: He was so esteemed though he was a false prophet.
LORD do so: That is, I would wish the same for God's honour and wealth of my people but he has appointed the contrary.

prophesied both against many countries: Meaning, that the prophets that denounced war or peace were tried either true or false by the success of their prophecies, even though God makes to come to pass sometimes that which the false prophet speaks to try the faith of his, De 13:3.

broke it: This declares the impudency of the wicked hirelings who have no zeal to the truth but are led with ambition to get the favour of men and therefore cannot abide any that might discredit them but burst forth into rages and contrary to their own conscience, pass not what lies they report or how wickedly they do so that they may maintain their estimation.
yoke of iron upon the neck: That is, a hard and cruel servitude.
beasts of the field also: Signifying that all would be his as in Da 2:38.

died the same year in the: Seeing this thing was evident in the eyes of the people and yet they returned not to the Lord, it is manifest that miracles cannot move us, neither the word itself, unless God touch the heart.
